laws.rule: Puebla's alcohol law (as reformed 16 July 2024) says no venue that sells alcohol may stay open, or let people stay or enter, after 02:30, and no alcohol may be sold or supplied after 02:00. Licences set each venue's days and hours, and municipal regulations cover some venue types (Ley para la Venta y Suministro de Bebidas Alcohólicas, art. 20).

Puebla charges a state tax on lodging services (Impuesto sobre Servicios de Hospedaje): lodging in hotels and similar places within the state, collected from guests by the provider. The rate is set each year in the state revenue law; the rate for the current year was not checked (Ley de Hacienda para el Estado, art. 22, 25 and 27).

OJN versions can lag the state gazette, so entries name the last reform shown on the text where it was visible.
